page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built upon the x86_64 architecture and operates dedicated AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration assigns 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU core.

Hardware accelerators are absent on this instance, with zero GPUs provisioned. The server provides no bundled local storage, necessitating reliance on network-attached storage volumes for system and runtime data. Network infrastructure offers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses upon provisioning.

The 1:2 compute-to-memory configuration reflects an architecture prioritized for processing density rather than large in-memory caches. This hardware allocation profile is suited for compute-heavy workloads that saturate multi-core CPUs without demanding large per-thread memory allocations, including distributed batch processing, source code compilation, video transcoding, and scalable web application backends.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor, powered by 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9T25 processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. The hardware profile is aligned with compute-focused processing tasks where high core counts and dedicated CPU cycles are required without demanding large per-thread memory footprints. Suitable deployment scenarios include high-throughput web serving, parallel batch processing, continuous integration compilation tasks, and compute-intensive distributed application workloads.
